name: Sawada Kazuki
source:
The protagonist of this work. His parents divorced when he was a child, and he was raised by his father.

Because of this, he has a strong yearning for his mother, but at the same time, he also has a sense of hatred toward her for abandoning him. Although she is a bit shy, she is warm-hearted and usually interacts with people she is familiar with in a cheerful manner.

She has had a longing and fondness for Mizuho, the mother of her best friend Yuya, since he was a child. He has been secretly developing a desire and obsession for Mizuho.

He has good grades in school and is a quick-witted person. He has a pure heart, but also has conflicting and distorted emotions.
